location_qualifier: beaches and hinterland west of the Matanikau; army assembled on the island by mid-October
composing_text: The 2nd Division and the survivors of the Kawaguchi and Ichiki Forces were then on the island; two battalions of the 38th Division were also present (Miller, chapter VI).
source_locator: R2225: ch. VI and note 13; R2228: vol. 1 of the same compilation, used for the army earlier orders
current_activity: army headquarters and main body assembled on Guadalcanal
notes: Miller, chapter VI: by mid-October 1942 General Hyakutake had assembled a sizable portion of 17th Army, except the main body of the 38th Division, on Guadalcanal, and intended to command the operation in person. The claim date 15 October is mid-month, not a single landing day for the headquarters. Confidence 0.5 (Miller’s mid-October phrase; a day-level landing log for the headquarters was not read). Rabaul remains the earlier rear headquarters (Miller, ch. IV) and is not given a claim in this increment.

location_qualifier: counter-offensive against the Lunga perimeter and Henderson Field
composing_text: The 2nd Division infantry regiments made the inland assault; the 4th, 16th and 29th Infantry are named in Miller, chapter VI, among the units whose combat strength was reduced.
source_locator: R2225: ch. VI (The October Counteroffensive); R2226: the October battles
current_activity: directing the October counter-offensive against the airfield
notes: Miller, chapter VI, and Zimmerman: the Japanese October counter-offensive against the Lunga airfield was fought on 23–26 October 1942. The claim date is 24 October, in the main infantry assaults. Confidence 0.7.

location_qualifier: Guadalcanal, now under 8th Area Army for the Solomons
source_locator: R2228: JACAR C25080231800, 件名 on operations 27 November–2 December (第八方面軍司令官及第十八軍司令官は十一月二十六日総帥を発動し第十七軍司令官は東部ニューギニヤ方面の作戦指揮を第十八軍司令官に移譲しソロモン群島方面の作戦に専任する事となれり)
current_activity: coming under 8th Area Army and specializing in the Solomons
notes: JACAR 17th Army operations record, vol. 1: on 26 November 1942 the 8th Area Army and 18th Army commanders assumed command; 17th Army transferred its eastern New Guinea operations to 18th Army and specialized in the Solomons. Confidence 0.5 (one Japanese official family; the metadata excerpt of that item was read, not every image of the volume). Location remains the army on Guadalcanal; 8th Area Army headquarters at Rabaul has no claim in this increment.
